transcript.text: I need to flag a facilities issue. The gymnasium floor will be sealed and inaccessible next Thursday from 7:00 a.m. through the end of the exercise. I received the work-order confirmation this week, but the closure hasn't been added to the exercise plan yet. The cafeteria is the approved alternate reunification site, so we should update the draft plan to use the cafeteria instead of the gymnasium.

transcript.text: I need to flag a medication storage issue. I confirmed this requirement while reviewing the health plans this week, but the draft plan still lists an on-site medication table. We need to update the plan to account for temperature-controlled medication storage at the nurse's office rather than a generic on-site medication table.
